mechanism: Fluphenazine (antipsychotic) may potentiate metoprolol's cardiac depressant effects and both agents can cause hypotension and CNS depression; fluphenazine may inhibit CYP2D6 metabolism of metoprolol.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and cardiac conduction regularly; assess for excessive CNS depression or hypotension; consider dose adjustment or alternative antipsychotic if adverse effects emerge.
